scopeNotes: Preserve lower-tier, upper-tier, and single-tier legal structures while mapping them to canonical municipal or regional body types.
Northern districts are administrative geographies, not municipal governments.

This manifest tracks the municipal-registry adapter layer only. The live Ontario receipts site is a separate, further-along evidence track: its FIR locks and the reviewed municipal directory live under sources/locks/ca-on/ and do not advance these stages until re-locked in the jurisdiction-source-lock format this contract validates.

The gap between a live Ontario site and an early manifest is therefore deliberate evidence discipline, not neglect: CONTRIBUTING forbids marking a stage complete ahead of the exact artifact the validator checks.
